results.name: pimelyl-[acyl-carrier protein] methyl ester esterase activity

definition.text: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-carboxyhexanoyl-[ACP] methyl ester + H2O = 6-carboxyhexanoyl-[ACP] + H+ + methanol.

results.comment: Note that while this reaction occurs on a modified protein (acyl-carrier protein), the ACP only acts as a carrier that later releases the end product.

synonyms.name: pimelyl-[acyl-carrier protein] methyl ester hydrolase activity
